verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed an llms.txt at dev.moonpay.com that returns HTTP 200 with a MoonPay Developer Docs index. MoonPay also documents a dedicated 'Using agents' page, which describes a docs MCP server that lets AI agents search and retrieve documentation content. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt), and the agent-oriented guidance is described only in a single sentence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://dev.moonpay.com/llms.txt # MoonPay Developer Docs
The documentation includes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents direct access to search and retrieve content.
